reason: The cited lines call a Git API via a connection and return branch/ref data as JSON, which supports reading SaaS repository data available through the configured credentials (SECRET). Branch/ref data such as branch names can be controlled by repository users, so the returned content is attacker-controllable (UNTRUSTED). The lines do not execute code on the host (HOSTEXEC not supported) and only query a fixed Git API rather than sending agent-supplied data to an attacker-chosen destination or writing public content (SINK not supported).
